title: One Strike, A Thousand Echoes
logline: A temple bell is struck once at dawn, and its sound fades slowly across the valley below, the same way, the keeper says, one sight can set off a long private echo of thought.

object.note: Object 5 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: Memory's long echo becomes a literal one: a temple bell struck once at dawn, its sound fading slowly across the valley.

thread_out.thread: From the echo that follows a single strike to a real task in progress, where contact, recognition and adjustment happen moment by moment.

requirements: A hill or rock temple with a bell and a keeper willing to be filmed
A vantage point to follow the sound into the valley below
Consent covering both the keeper's work and his personal reflections

suggestions.name: A rock or hill temple in the Kandy-Matale hills
suggestions.why: The Kandy-Matale hills hold numerous rock and hill temples overlooking farming valleys.
suggestions.access_notes: Specific temple and monastic permission would need to be arranged directly.
